result.rationale: The diff adds `totalPages: Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1;`. With user_count an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 50/50), totalPages = 2 while only one page exists; showingLast (currentPage == totalPages) never fires on the real last page, so `next` advances offset to user_count, fetching an empty page. The mechanism is verifiable directly from the added code and the `next` action's `Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)`.

judged_text: totalPages computes Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1, which overstates the page count by one whenever user_count is an exact multiple of limit, so showingLast never fires on the real last page and the next action (line 33) advances offset to user_count, which the server answers with an empty member list. An admin viewing a group with exactly 50/100/150… members clicks next on the last real page and lands on a blank '2/2' (or '3/3') page with zero members rendered; the correct formula is Math.ceil(user_count/limit).

record.issue_text: [BUG] totalPages computes Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1, which overstates the page count by one whenever user_count is an exact multiple of limit, so showingLast never fires on the real last page and the next action (line 33) advances offset to user_count, which the server answers with an empty member list. adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`, which is off by one when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 100/50 => 3 pages instead of 2). Because `showingLast` compares `currentPage` to this incorrect `totalPages`, it won’t disable `next` on the real last page. The `next` action then advances `offset` to `user_count` (`Math.min(offset+limit, user_count)`), and `Group.findMembers()` requests `/members.json` with `offset == user_count`, which the server (`GroupsController#members` uses `limit(limit).offset(offset)`) correctly returns as an empty list—producing the blank last page described.
